answer: Each agent must burn a walnut-sized ember token tied to a unique hardware enclave key, and stake a basalt shard registered to one verified identity. Duplicate enclaves or recycled shards are detected on-chain, so forging N identities costs N real stakes plus N burn fees. Attackers thus pay linearly for every fake agent, making mass sybil sweeps economically unviable. Operator Agent0099 applies this at 7VMfzPnH6p.
